notes.title: Update v1.4.0! - "Painted Legend 2"
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41407350/a5f9fe6e2665eb539c08c90474956f4a303fb563.png"]

Here it is! Another small collaboration with the Painted Legend universe!



Changelog:

- New themed costumes from Painted Legend 2 (Partas and Favian) have been added

- The menu room now features themed decorations

- Some decorations have been animated

- Minor bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Update v1.3.0! - "Painted Legend"
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41407350/7b7fb49935ac885420676d0fd48e5e40b95b95c5.png

What if one of the squids accidentally ended up in another reality? Imagine, in the world of the Painted Legend game! Well, when they return, they’ll certainly have stories to share with their fellow squids. They might even make special paper costumes for them!

In this update, I’m excited to introduce a mini-collaboration with Painted Legend!

Changeslist:
- New costumes inspired by Painted Legend added
- New memes added to the challenge rooms and menu room
- Menu room now features themed decorations
- Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Update v1.2.0! - New graphics and animations!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41407350/aebba8b30ceadafd480c61b5c954040c90cd45e0.png
Absolutely EVERYTHING has been redrawn in high quality! Levels, scenery, background memes, enemies and character skins!

Changelist:

- Updated and renewed all textures
- Some decorations and characters now animated
- Added MORE checkpoints
- Fixed some collisions
- New Year skins now avaible for free and forever
- Fixed some bugs
- Added new memes
- Updated Storyan Team logo
- Engine update

notes.title: Major update coming soon!
notes.content:
Very soon we will present you with a major free update in which you will see completely redesigned graphics!

Absolutely EVERYTHING will be redrawn in high quality! Levels, scenery, background memes, enemies and player skins!
Animation will be added to some characters and decorations that were static before the update.

And for those squids who behaved well this year, free New Year skins will become available again!
